title: A malformed relay in a correction gets the repair-relays recovery
description: A malformed relay in a correction gets the repair-relays recovery
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the correction ledger's read match REQ-change-relayed-decision-001 and REQ-change-relay-repair-001: a damaged relay is refused with its recovery, repair-relays for an active change and git checkout HEAD for an archived one. load_correction_ledger reported a bare invalid correction ledger.
acceptance_criteria: A malformed relayed_by in an approval a corrections.json correction embeds, or one naming someone other than that approval's actor, is refused naming specsync change repair-relays <id> for an active change, and git checkout HEAD -- <file> for an archived one; repair-relays then fixes it and the ledger reads (red then green)
